A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Ca2+ release is a necessary but not sufficient condition for the activation of Ca(2+)-permeable channels in the plasma membrane of avian nasal glands.

the activation of Ca(2+) entry in this system is not due to an increase in the driving force for Ca(2+) influx, but is instead dependent upon an unknown messenger which is produced as a result of the depletion and/or refilling of intracellular Ca(2+) stores.
